title: India Invites Russia to 18th BRICS Summit in New Delhi
detail: India, holding the 2026 BRICS chairmanship, formally sent Russia an invitation to the 18th BRICS Summit in New Delhi, scheduled for September 12-13. A Russian government source confirmed to TASS that the invitation had been dispatched; the Kremlin has said Putin plans to attend alongside fellow BRICS leaders including Xi Jinping, as the bloc's 11 members focus on local-currency payment infrastructure amid Western sanctions pressure.

media.caption: India dispatches formal invitation to Russia for the September BRICS summit in New Delhi.
